releaseNotes: OTA v59 publishes the Growth V3 editorial reader cleanup: dedicated title-and-body hierarchy for decision steps, recognition signals and calibration; sentence-case Source Serif teaching titles; flatter Decision Labs with one exercise container instead of nested cards; denser reading typography; preserved AI practice, history, real-world application and lesson navigation; removal of the superseded V2 reader; and the obsolete V2 build transform removed from the OTA pipeline.
